purpose: Separate a 27B sampling repeat from an exploratory larger-model capacity comparison. Neither is pooled with other batches.

r14.difference_from_r11: model, checkpoint precision and inference hardware configuration; same agent and numerical tools

primary_outcome: One complete six-world batch with at least five raw scores >=90; 122B is a separate-model baseline and not a successful 27B reproduction.
limitations: Single batch per configuration; not a stable success probability estimate
Different model/precision/TP topology prevents attributing difference only to parameter count
Do not select per-world bests across batches
